paragraphs: He is mentioned in Vayikra Rabbah 28:6; Yalkut, Emor, reads R' Chama bar Chanina.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman’s heading fully writes Rav Chama bar Chalafta. The Midrash Rabbah — TE digital text of Vayikra Rabbah 28:6 fully writes Rabbi Chama bar Rabbi Chalafta. Hyman’s separate Yalkut, Emor, Chama bar Chanina variant is retained as his report.

The actual Midrash Rabbah — TE Vayikra Rabbah 28:6 paragraph has Rabbi Chama bar Rabbi Chalafta. Hyman’s fully written Rav heading remains distinct. The separate Yalkut Emor Chanina reading remains his report, with its abbreviated title retained as R' in the new body; that Yalkut occurrence was not freshly collated. The current mixed note stays verbatim and no paternal title is transferred.
